### Beaver Conflict & Restoration Screening Tool

::: card-tags
[ArcGIS Pro]{.tag} [Python]{.tag} [Risk Screening]{.tag} [Hydrology]{.tag}
:::

Screens stream segments for human-beaver conflict risk and restoration opportunity, then summarizes results by county, watershed, or custom planning area. A Python tool for ArcGIS Pro that combines BRAT modeled dam capacity with NLCD land cover and impervious surface, uses ESRI Living Atlas services as default inputs, and flags low-confidence land cover for field verification.

::: card-links
[GitHub](https://github.com/zcramton/csu_nr_426/tree/main/FinalProject){target="_blank"}
:::

### CSU Micromobility Impact Report

::: card-tags
[Transportation Demand Management]{.tag} [Micromobility]{.tag} [Program Evaluation]{.tag} [Policy]{.tag}
:::

Documents the performance of CSU’s student fee-funded micromobility program in its first year, with ridership data, program outcomes, and policy recommendations for campus active transportation infrastructure. Written on behalf of ATFAB and CSU Transportation for the Association for Commuter Transportation’s 2025 Transportation Demand Management Impact Report.

### NASA GLOBE Mosquito Habitat Mapper — CitSci Migration

::: card-tags
[Community Science]{.tag} [Data Management]{.tag} [Project Management]{.tag} [Urban Ecology]{.tag}
:::

Explored whether the CitSci platform could back up and expand community mosquito habitat reporting in Fort Collins by piloting a migration of NASA GLOBE Observer’s Mosquito Habitat Mapper. The final report covers project outcomes, platform assessment, stakeholder engagement, and ongoing implementation challenges.

::: card-links
[Report (PDF)](media/ess440_MosquitoMapperMigrationReport.pdf){target="_blank"}
[ArcGIS StoryMap](https://arcg.is/CS8f){target="_blank"}

### Life Cycle Assessment — Soap Refill Packaging

::: card-tags
[Life Cycle Assessment]{.tag} [OpenLCA]{.tag} [Uncertainty Analysis]{.tag} [Sustainability Science]{.tag}
:::

Tested the common marketing claim that laminate refill pouches are better for the environment than plastic bottles, and found pouches carry equal or greater impact across most categories. Comparative LCI and LCIA in OpenLCA using ecoinvent 3.11 and ReCiPe 2016 midpoint, with Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis.

::: card-links
[LCI Report (PDF)](media/ess555_lci_report.pdf){target="_blank"}
[LCIA Report (PDF)](media/ess555_final_report.pdf){target="_blank"}
:::
::::::

Spring 2025

### Starship Delivery Robots — Campus Perception Study

::: card-tags
[Public Engagement]{.tag} [Survey Research]{.tag} [Transportation]{.tag} [Mixed Methods]{.tag} 
:::

A mixed-methods study assessing student perceptions of Starship food delivery robots at CSU using in-person interviews, Likert-scale surveys, and thematic analysis. Findings revealed predominantly negative sentiment centered on inefficiency, resource misprioritization, and concerns that the robots displace more sustainable alternatives like walking and cycling.

::: card-links
[Report (PDF)](media/ess312_final_report.pdf){target="_blank"}
:::

## Photography

::: section-intro
I'm an amateur photographer with an interest in macro, landscape, street, and aerial drone photography. I volunteer with the City of Fort Collins Natural Areas to capture events, restoration work, and programs in support of the City's outreach and public communication efforts.

A dedicated gallery is in development.
:::
